brief: WEB-2107 (S2, L): `docs/LEGAL_RELEASE.md` lost the evidence behind privacy §7's meeting rules and §4's Vertex AI wording. This isn't a change this run made, and the last attempt was not a fix: in round 1 the final check failed `tests/ux-web-legal-meetings.spec.ts:91` at `expect(release).toContain("finished or not")` (:95), and the tester's repair in the main checkout couldn't clear it because the cause is committed. The file has the text at 20e6826 and lacks it at c77deb1, d9f0a3d and HEAD. The published pages are right (`src/content/legal/en.ts:57-63` already say Vertex AI and link ‘Google Cloud service terms, including Vertex AI’); only the release record is wrong.

Edit 1, restore the section. In `docs/LEGAL_RELEASE.md`, between the paragraph that starts ‘The website email button opens a translated message’ (HEAD line 30) and `## Operating the published policy` (HEAD line 32), insert the whole section `## Evidence behind meeting-notes and AI wording` exactly as it stands at commit 20e6826, lines 32–40: the heading, its paragraph starting ‘Version 2026-11-06 adds meeting notes’, and its five bullets (‘Meeting notes are Pro only, with up to 20 hours a month…’, ‘The server transcribes each piece on Vertex AI…’, ‘Whatever is left of a meeting on the server, finished or not, is deleted 30 days after its last piece arrived… 7 days after the app first asks about it (MN-26…)… UX-2717). Take it from `git show 20e6826:docs/LEGAL_RELEASE.md` (sed -n 32,41p) and paste it unchanged, with one blank line before and after, so the file reads: deletion section, blank line, meeting-notes section, blank line, Operating section.
